title: Derive the model-guard fixture's model names from the config it copies
action: packages/bee/hooks/test_model_guard.mjs copies the REAL .bee/config.json into its fixtures (:66, :95) and then hardcodes the literal 'sonnet' at eight-plus sites as 'a model that is configured'. The guard under test derives its answer from that config -- correctly, per AO5/B5, config is the sole authority with no hardcoded allowlist. So the moment the repo's models.claude.generation.model is set to anything other than sonnet, the guard rightly denies and the suite reports a failure that says nothing about the real situation: 'sonnet is not a model configured for any claude tier'. That is exactly the defect class this feature exists to close -- a gate comparing a hand-authored literal against derived ground truth. It is live right now: the working tree has generation.model set to opus and the suite is red. FIX: read the copied config in the test and derive the model name to use wherever a configured model is required, instead of writing one in. Handle the sites that assert on stderr CONTENT too (around :552 the message is expected to name two tier models) -- those need the derived names as well, not a second hardcoded pair. Do NOT change .bee/config.json; the model choice is the owner's and is not this cell's business. Do NOT weaken any assertion or add a hardcoded allowlist to the guard. After the fix the suite must pass with generation.model set to opus AND still pass if it is set back to sonnet -- prove both.

truths: node packages/bee/hooks/test_model_guard.mjs exits 0 with the current config
The suite still passes when generation.model is temporarily set to a different configured value
No literal model name remains where the test means 'a configured model'
No assertion was weakened or removed

artifacts.substantive: model names derived from the copied config

key_links: the derived name comes from the same config the fixture copies, not a second source
prohibitions: No hardcoded allowlist added to the guard
No assertion weakened to make the suite pass

trace.outcome: test_model_guard.mjs derives every model name from the config its fixture copies (modelForTier over CONFIGURABLE_SLOTS + resolveAdvisor, mirroring dispatch-guard's configuredModelSet) instead of hardcoding 'sonnet'; suite green at opus-4-5-20251101, sonnet, opus, and an all-slots-identical config, with 115 check() calls unchanged and .bee/config.json untouched.
